title: Jude and the Language
author: Sebastian Yarrow
blurb: August Lockridge, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
